newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan food shares plunge on pork export ban.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan food shares plunge on pork export ban.

text.p: Taiwan's food sector suffered heavy losses at mid-morning on Friday after the government banned exports of fresh and frozen pork temporarily due to an outbreak of the deadly and contagious foot and mouth disease.
After 90 minutes, the entire food sector tumbled four percet, while the main index was down 0.64 percent.
"This will have a huge impact on related food companies," said Lin Long-hsien, an analyst for United Securities.
Most livestock shares plunged by the daily seven percent limit.
Ace Foods and Hui Shung Agriculture and Food Corp were limit down, falling T$2.6 and T$2.0 to T$34.7 and T$26.6, respectively.
Japan's Agriculture Ministry said on Friday that Japan had banned pork imports from Taiwan indefiniately. South Korea also announced a similar ban.
